meta.title: Mammut Space Cabin | 42 m² Smart Prefab Cabin
meta.description: Space Cabin by Mammut: a 42 m² smart prefabricated cabin with a galvanised steel frame, fibreglass shell, polyurethane insulation, double glazing and app control. Four versions, installed in one day.
meta.ogAlt: 3D render of the Mammut Space Cabin at dusk

hero.lead: Space Cabin is a 42 m² smart prefab with a galvanised frame, a seamless fibreglass shell and full app control. Four versions. Installed in a single day.

teaser.text: The official Space Cabin teaser — from the production line to its first night under the stars.

features.title: Engineered for every climate, designed for living
features.text: Every layer of the Space Cabin was chosen for a reason: longer life, lower energy bills and more comfort.

items.title: Galvanised steel frame
items.text: Hot-dip galvanised chassis resists rust and humidity, and sits on adjustable legs.

items.title: Fibreglass shell
items.text: A seamless moulded body with a glossy gel-coat: light, UV-resistant and never needs painting.

items.title: Polyurethane insulation
items.text: Up to 100 mm of sprayed PU foam keeps summer heat and winter cold outside.

items.title: Double glazing
items.text: A panoramic window in argon-filled Low-E double glazing lets in full daylight with minimal heat loss.

items.title: Smart system
items.text: Lighting, climate, blinds and the door lock, all controlled from your phone, even remotely.

items.title: One-day install
items.text: The cabin arrives complete from the factory. Connect water, power and drainage and you're in.

items.title: Solar ready
items.text: Pre-routed wiring and roof mounts for PV panels, ready for off-grid sites.

items.title: Relocatable
items.text: No permanent concrete foundation. Move the cabin whenever you want to.

shell.title: Fibreglass shell
shell.text: A one-piece body moulded with marine-grade gel-coat. No seams, fully waterproof and UV-resistant.

glass.title: Panoramic window
glass.text: Low-E double glazing in a thermally broken aluminium frame, with a 7-metre view.

frame.title: Galvanised chassis
frame.text: Hot-dip galvanised main and cross beams on 8 adjustable legs for uneven ground.

insulation.title: PU insulation
insulation.text: Sprayed polyurethane between the outer shell and the inner lining. No thermal bridges.

smart.title: Smart panel
smart.text: Digital lock, lighting and climate control from the entry panel or the mobile app.

led.title: LED contour light
led.text: A light line that traces the capsule silhouette at night, with adjustable colour and brightness.

deck.title: Timber deck
deck.text: A thermo-wood deck with a glass balustrade extends the living room outdoors.

plan.title: 42 m² without a wasted centimetre
plan.text: A linear layout carries daylight from the panoramic window into every zone. Tap any area.

zones.title: Bedroom

items.q: How much does the Space Cabin cost?
items.a: It depends on the version, your customisations and the installation site. You can see base prices in the comparison section, and a consultation will give you the final figure.

items.q: How long do production and delivery take?
items.a: Production takes 30–45 days depending on the version. On-site installation takes a single day.

items.q: Does it need a concrete foundation?
items.a: No. The cabin stands on adjustable galvanised legs. A levelled, compacted surface or a few small concrete pads is enough.

items.q: How does it perform in extreme heat or cold?
items.a: Up to 100 mm of PU insulation and Low-E double glazing keep it comfortable in cold mountain climates and hot southern ones alike.
The cabin is a relocatable structure, but local rules vary. Our team will guide you during the consultation.

items.q: What can the smart system do?
items.a: It controls lighting, climate, motorised blinds and the digital lock. Zenith adds cameras and an alarm. Everything works from the mobile app, even remotely.
Yes. Payments are staged with production progress, and instalment plans are available on selected versions.

items.q: What about warranty and after-sales service?
items.a: The structure is covered for up to 10 years and equipment for 2 years, with after-sales service nationwide.
